entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Alex. I... I hope you can help me. I'm just so confused. I bought these new cycling shoes about a month ago, and I don't think they're right for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Umm, let me see. Yes, it's VF886-012. The problem is, they're just so uncomfortable. I've tried to ride with them twice and I'm getting terrible blisters on my heels.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloFit Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on December 19th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. And the cleats... I just can't seem to get them positioned correctly. It's all very overwhelming. I just want a refund, but I don't understand the policy. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you. One moment please.
Okay, I've reviewed the policy. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send them back?

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex. You've been a huge help. I was so worried I was stuck with them.
Not a problem at all. Once our warehouse receives the return, your full refund will be processed back to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
